versions.changelog:
Version 1.2.5

- No file changes detected in this release.
- Functionality, documentation, and all settings remain unchanged.

Initial release of cn-ascii-art.

- Convert text (English and Chinese) into ASCII art.
- Multiple font styles supported: standard, banner, narrow, block.
- Simple CLI usage with customizable font options.
- Python 3.x required; uses pyfiglet for rendering.
- Handles basic text to ASCII art with examples and usage notes included.
